faq.question: Q1. What is the post name in MPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The post name is Dental Surgeon (Manipur Health Service Grade-IV).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are released under MPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 13 Dental Surgeon posts are available.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay scale for MPSC Dental Surgeon posts?
Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Dental Surgeon posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must have a recognised Dental qualification included under the Indian Dental Act, 1948 and registration with a State Dental Council.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for MPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 38 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for MPSC Dental Surgeon Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 18 October 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for General candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC candidates have to pay Rs. 600/-.
